scripts.cloc: for package in packages/* packages/*/*; do if [ -f "$package/package.json" ]; then printf '\n%s\n' "$package"; git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -- "$package" | cloc --list-file=-; fi; done
scripts.prettier: git ls-files -coz --exclude-standard -- packages examples | xargs -0 prettier --write --ignore-unknown
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
